verdict.rationale: The official README says Gemini CLI can 'debug issues and troubleshoot with natural language', query and edit large codebases, and help with debugging when @-mentioned in issues and PRs. Community reports are mixed: one user says it navigates large codebases effortlessly and another says its code review catches real bugs, but other hands-on users report it gets stuck in error loops, fails basic read/edit calls, and navigates codebases poorly. missing for 10: documented workflow for reproducing issues (e.g., running code or tests to trigger bugs), explicit support for verifying fixes, and consistent independent corroboration of reliable root-cause debugging.
